source_text: אַ֤ךְ אֶת זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִ/כֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָ/ע֔וֹף הַ/הֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר לא כְרָעַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּ֣עַל לְ/רַגְלָ֔י/ו לְ/נַתֵּ֥ר בָּ/הֵ֖ן עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ־־־־׃
english_snapshot: Yet these you may eat from all the swarming things that fly[b][a], that go on all fours: those that have jointed legs above their feet to hop on the ground with them.

signals.text: Hebrew textual tradition reads literally 'which not legs'; the traditional reading understood by context and ancient versions is 'which have legs.'
